name: hbar-usd-checkout
description: USD-priced checkout settled in HBAR: Chainlink HBAR/USD data feed prices each payment on-chain, receipts are written to Hedera Consensus Service and read back from the mirror node.

steps.text: USD checkout settled in HBAR, priced by Chainlink and receipted on HCS. The frontend already points at a live Checkout contract on Hedera testnet.

steps.label: Fund your wallet with testnet HBAR
Copy the frontend env file and add your testnet account
Import a deployer account and deploy your own Checkout

steps.text: README.md walks through every step; AGENTS.md briefs your coding agent.
